criterion.text: Alterar prazo em compromisso sem regra de cancelamento não cria economia artificial; regra existente determina o efeito.

observedContractLimits: PlannerSensitivityUnits issues only a finite replace amount in its declared currency, or a confirmed existing source-only USD forecast. A changed period or defer selector is not a supported amount parameter.

Planner defer moves an existing monthly forecast to a valid destination through the canonical Planner command. That operation alone does not establish a contractual cancellation or termination saving.
The inspected Procurement scenario adapter prepares only an evidenced requisition amount replacement with the same currency and period.

The inspected Vendor Contract reader exposes existing authorized contract fields, including end/renewType/notice, but does not return a sensitivity cost-effect/cancellation-rule proof. This is an observation of these ports, not a claim that no rule exists anywhere in the repository.

requiredOwnerContract.authority: An existing authorized commitment source and exact rule/source evidence, retaining incarnation, source version, command CAS, horizon, declared currency and current principal/grant.
requiredOwnerContract.effect: Use only a cost effect computed by the existing canonical cancellation/commitment producer. With no supported rule or evidence, refuse the effect or keep it unavailable; do not infer savings from a shorter displayed date.
requiredOwnerContract.parameter: Expose a private typed parameter binding with its real unit and supported values. Never relabel an amount selector as duration.
requiredOwnerContract.result: Return canonical scenario/comparison refs, missing states, coverage and provenance that WP13 can persist and revalidate. Exact thresholds require the domain proof; nonlinear/unsupported intervals remain sampled or unavailable.
requiredOwnerContract.boundary: Any needed domain adapter is an owner delta. No engine, policy, financial formula, transport contract or foreign runtime source is altered in this delivery.

requiredHostedOracles: Real commitment with no cancellation rule: vary requested term; no fabricated saving and no zero substitution.
Same commitment with an already existing authorized cancellation rule: the canonical cost effect determines every sample; retain rule/source version and absence/FX states.
Rule revoked or changed, wrong currency/unit/period, missing source and changed incarnation must refuse the old persisted proof.
Original human choice remains historical; an updated sample does not apply cancellation or record a new decision.
currentAcceptance: NOT_ESTABLISHED. Price sensitivity, generic unit tests, ordinary monthly defer and source-only renewal are not claimed to satisfy the cancellation-rule criterion.
nextAction: WP03/WP04 expose or identify the canonical existing commitment/cancellation producer and publish a pinned adapter; WP13 consumes that pin, composes its sampler and adds both exact hosted counterexamples. S0 retains this as a mandatory behavior/proof gate.
